comments: 34e0ba1f: This section of code is responsible for handling the data entry for Deficiency Tracking in the IRT (Incomplete Records Tracking) module.
0b763658: Prompt user for event date and validate input.
fe03e338: Check if the event date is after the admission date.
78b821e5: Ensure the event date is not after the discharge date.
ead107c3: If the deficiency type is '1', set the last admission date.
85487272: For types other than '1', set the event date with a time of 23:59 if no time is provided.
d6d39761: Retrieve patient's last admission information if the deficiency type is '1'.
369012d1: Remove previous user prompts and, if ward information is available, pre-fill the ward field.
124d1aae: Prompt for ward location, validate entry, and retrieve corresponding service.
1f8ed0bb: If treating specialty information is available, pre-fill the field.
691d3c2c: Prompt user for treating specialty and validate input.
46af48b4: If no corresponding entry in the Ward file, use the service from the Clinic Stop file.
c8a04fe1: If a corresponding ward is found, use the service associated with the ward.
3decbf57: Determine the service value and pre-fill it if possible.
21963b56: Prompt for service and validate input.
bf5fefe1: Retrieve the physician's name based on the discharge or transfer event.
14d29e65: Prompt user for primary physician and validate input.
6c106492: Set the default action to 'A' if the deficiency resolution status matches certain criteria and is initiated by the system.
23acfc79: Set the default action based on the deficiency resolution status when manually initiated.
cfbec43a: Determine and prompt for secondary physician based on the deficiency resolution status and action.
3c46fcbb: Pre-fill the primary physician's name if it exists.
1d0bb145: Prompt for provider and validate input.
edeb1c53: File the new entry in the Deficiency file.
8577e6e9: Set editing flags and prepare the new entry for detailed input.
29f8b887: Check if the document type requires a certain input form and set it accordingly.
713d597d: For certain document types, set a different input form.
f785271e: Execute the input form.
df2be85d: Re-initialize the list of deficiencies after processing.
816e5987: Handle user exit actions, ensuring the display is refreshed correctly.
66add81f: Terminate processing of the current routine.
c3f10d43: Scan for unfiled deficiencies for the patient.
8876ba2a: End of screening process.
9119c20c: Filter and display deficiencies based on division and status.
f093d4cf: Display the deficiency information to the user.
b605bc69: End of the detailed deficiency display.
d6c0cc00: Check division match for the deficiency.
a81d52e4: Adjust the deficiency resolution based on division settings.
2cf39d19: Set the deficiency status based on whether it's signed or reviewed.
d8cc876f: Retrieve information related to the patient's admission event to determine the responsible physician.
725cda82: Format the physician's name for display.
10fdb7df: Determine the appropriate physician based on the action (Admitting, Attending, etc.)
1cf32ae5: Set the physician ID based on the type of action (A for Admitting, etc.).
8e732584: End of physician determination process.
19a342c0: Retrieve and format the admission type for display.
95ad7143: End of the admission type retrieval process.
473ddab2: Temporary storage setup for report generation.
b13fdd39: Clear the temporary storage to ensure clean state.
632d51ba: Initialize variables for report generation.
91b9af7e: Set up the initial state for report display.
b9aef9eb: Display message if no deficiency was created.
2425b06f: Call to generate the report view.
0b1ee403: Terminate the temporary storage setup.
2205d350: Handle navigation to a specific category based on user selection.
d45f2061: Prompt user for category selection.
e41e40f4: Handle user cancellation or exit from the prompt.
3c42f4bb: Retry category selection if initial attempt is unsuccessful.
bab6efc9: Initialize variable for category selection.
cffd169e: Set the selected category for navigation.
f92e0d09: Notify user if the selected category contains no deficiencies.
0f98b718: Update display to show selected category.
45ffd56e: End of jump processing.
